name: Cheapanet
summary: Sydney unlimited dialup ISP ($19.95/mo, 2:1 ratio); later pivoted to ADSL as 'CheapaDSL'; dead c.2013 (CHEAPANET PTY LIMITED, ACN 087 951 004, renamed PIP TOTAL IT SOLUTIONS PTY LTD Apr 2014).

events.details: CHEAPANET PTY LIMITED ACN 087951004 registered 07 Jun 1999; ABN from 1 Nov 1999. Renamed PIP TOTAL IT SOLUTIONS PTY LTD 16 Apr 2014.

refs.label: ABN History: Cheapanet Pty Limited ACN 087951004

events.details: Retail long outlasted 2005: the unlimited-dialup homepage persisted (same capture 2004-2008), then the site rebranded to 'CheapaDSL' offering unlimited ADSL (256/64 $45/mo) across 2009-2012 captures; company renamed PIP TOTAL IT SOLUTIONS PTY LTD 16 Apr 2014, by which point cheapanet.com.au was empty/parked.
